name: @waniwani/cli
description: WaniWani CLI for MCP development workflow

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && tsup
scripts.release: npm whoami && bun run build && npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm whoami && bun run build && npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm whoami && bun run build && npm version major && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:beta: npm whoami && bun run build && npm version prerelease --preid beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta

author: WaniWani
